snippet.title: Luduvo Devlog #1: Website, Website, Website!
snippet.description:
https://luduvo.com

This devlog mainly highlights updates we've made to the Luduvo website over the course of the last ~2 weeks. We wanted to show this to the much broader public as this has been previously alpha tester exclusive until now! 🔥
